headline: Short-period south slop under cross-on wind — skip it today.
today: 2.5ft but it's 4-second south junk and the SW wind is cross-on from morning on. Weak and textured, not worth the drive. Save it for Saturday.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SE angle to 2.6ft but SSW turns onshore through the day — dawn is the only semi-clean window and it's marginal.
Bumps to 2.7ft but S onshore 10-11mph — bumpy and disorganized, likely a pass.
The day here. 2-plus feet SSE at a good angle with N offshore through the morning. Clean and worth the drive early — fish or shortboard before the afternoon cross-on shift.
